text.description_html:
Laurey 57559, Nantucket Cabinet Pull in Satin Pewter

The Satin Pewter Nantucket Knot Cabinet Pull has the coastal grandma aesthetic; it is perfect for seaside homes and homes with nautical decor that want something fresh for this year. The Nantucket Cabinet Pull in Satin Pewter will contrast beautifully with dark kitchen cabinets. It has a standard 3 inch center to center mounting and is 4.5 inches overall. The Laurey 57559 3 Inch Nantucket Pull in Satin Pewter comes packaged with the mounting hardware.

This cabinet pull is part of the Laurey Nantucket Collection.

Specifications and Features of the Laurey 57559 3 Inch Nantucket Pull in Satin Pewter:

  • Material: Steel
  • Finish: Satin Pewter
  • Length c.c. (center to center): 3"
  • Overall Length: 4-1/2"
  • Width: 7/8"
  • Projection: 1-1/4"
  • Packaged with 1" long #8-32 screws and 1-1/2" long #8-32 screws.

Available finishes:
Satin Pewter Matte Black Antique Pewter

Sold Individually
